decision: Accept the exact dated articles for local source integration; production acceptance remains pending

records.determination: One regional line across two opening stages, not multiple projects or a city-only system. Full opening controls operating-stage wording; prospective overview language, future stations, technical provision and measured outcomes remain separate.

One Federal Territory municipal place, not Greater Kuala Lumpur or a monitoring catchment. Strategic goals, reported gazette/effective dates, detailed controls and service responsibilities retain their distinct evidence roles.
One Federal Territory, not twenty precincts or wetland cells. The bus announcement remains prospective historical evidence; water design and ICT responsibilities do not become measured performance.

review_checks: Fourteen selected official source records inspected November 22 in America/Edmonton: eleven HTML bodies and three official indexed-text records. No new translated-reading identity or independent review is claimed.

All three identities and aliases were screened against historical eligibility, Phase 119, Phase 191/192 and preceding named additions. No exact earlier identity or country acquisition docket is reused.
Eighteen substantive sections, fourteen chronology events and 528/564/553 body words are integrated. Five source-bound sections and one editorial evidence test per article.

The English MRT project URL timed out twice; the Malay overview was read directly. Its retrospective opening reference coexists with future-tense wording. The post-event English opening accounts control actual opening stages.

The phase-one event account says twelve stations; a search-discovered February 2023 PDF excerpt says eleven. The PDF was not inspected as an artifact and this batch does not assert a phase-one station count. Train capacities of 1,200 in the overview and 1,204 in technical information were also not collapsed into one figure.

Technical equipment and backup power are design descriptions, not sustained availability or independent safety acceptance. Corridor population is not observed ridership; five future stations are not operating additions.

The library synopsis was available as official indexed text after two direct timeouts. Its October 19 gazette and November 23 effective dates remain distinct; the underlying gazette was not inspected. The structure-plan portal’s stage-completion label does not replace them.

KLCCC root and roles pages were available as official indexed text after direct timeouts. No live camera, journey planner or transaction was tested. The root’s inconsistent road-distance figures are excluded.
The GoKL detailed page timed out twice. Search-discovered conflicting fare text was not used for current fare advice; the separate roles page supports only responsibilities.

Putrajaya’s 2014 history is a retrospective, not a 2026 constitutional action. Wetland function is distinct from monitoring results. The archived bus notice window is not a publication timestamp; January 1, 2023 is the announced start, not an observed completion.

Four substantive Malay sources were interpreted by Codex, including two pages with English navigation. Language and AI interpretation are traceable without claiming independent language review or adding translation identities.

Unused PDFs, videos, images and dynamic services were not represented as inspected underlying artifacts. All prior cohorts, 34 readings, evidence receipts and thirteen primary identities are preserved; publication, launch and stewardship remain separate.
